scope: Independent saved-evidence semantic review for personas 001-012 only. Eleven completed receipted candidates; uncertain 011 excluded. Every assigned success and recovery criterion for the eleven complete candidates is covered. Final current-valid audit and global raw hashes remain the parent terminal reconciliation gate.

verification.png_policy: Cited PNG pixels inspected directly or byte-identical to an inspected registered PNG after this session file was independently rehashed. Findings remain bound to each session and observation.

evidence_limits: DOM membership alone does not prove privacy-notice visibility; 001-004 have no notice-exposing scroll/view.
The first-screen sample card is only partially exposed; no claim that both sample/login labels are readable in the PNG.
Imported 1/1/0 counts and detailed negative-import errors use registered DOM/storage proof; not all counts or error copy are visible in the captured viewport.

Expected negative-input errors are actual recoverable failures; the conditional criterion is existential, with no every-failure quantifier. Later negative-import recovery is unattempted in 009/010/012.
No cancel or large-file criterion is assigned to 001-012. These sessions do not prove a retest of the earlier 51-104 ms cancellation window.
No old-run overrides or raw receipt changes; no whole-cohort or product-readiness claim.

excluded_jobs.assessment: All four success criteria and one recovery criterion are unassessed and excluded; no helper decisions.
excluded_jobs.classification: model/tool-selection error reaching a runner authorization guard; not a product failure
excluded_jobs.known_boundary: Frozen ScaleBrowserHost._authorize_legacy_seed runs before any _exchange. This task lacks PRD-IMPORT-SNAPSHOT-UNKNOWN, so legacy_seed_task_not_authorized is a known pre-dispatch rejection.
excluded_jobs.cleanup_status_at_review: Closure pending stage finalization. The active stage owner retains shutdown responsibility; no leak conclusion or external cleanup attempt.
